attributes.name: show-next-day
attributes.description: Show next-day marker when end is earlier than start; skips swap on confirm. Without it, times are ordered on confirm only

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Tooltip type, can be set to `default` `primary` `info` `success` `warning` `danger`

attributes.name: strategy
attributes.description: Tooltip position strategy, optional value is `absolute` `fixed`

attributes.name: offset-x
attributes.description: The x-axis offset, relative to the tooltip-aligned position

attributes.name: offset-y
attributes.description: The y-axis offset, relative to the tooltip-aligned position

attributes.name: popup-container
attributes.description: The location of the tooltip mount

attributes.name: auto-fit-popup-width
attributes.description: Whether to same width as trigger element

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Tooltip trigger method, optional value is `click` `hover` `manual`

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: The trigger element associated with the tooltip, the `string` type is the descendant element selector of the menu component, the `HTMLElement` type is any specified element node

attributes.name: close-on-click-reference
attributes.description: Whether to close the menu when clicking the reference element

attributes.name: esc-to-close
attributes.description: Whether to support keyboard ESC to close the tooltip

events.name: opened
events.description: Triggered when the open `Tooltip` animation ends

events.name: closed
events.description: Triggered when the closing `Tooltip` animation ends

events.name: click-outside
events.description: Triggered when clicking outside the tooltip

slots.name: click-outside
slots.description: Triggered when clicking outside the menu

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Accepted file type, consistent with the native attribute

attributes.name: capture
attributes.description: Get the file, the same as the native property

attributes.name: elevation
attributes.description: Elevation level, options `true` `false` and level of `0-24`, not in simple mode

attributes.name: max-file-size
attributes.description: Maximum file size, the unit is `byte`

attributes.name: show-file-list
attributes.description: Whether to show the file list

attributes.name: resolve-type
attributes.description: object-url: Blob URL; file: File only; data-url: Base64 URL

events.name: after-read
events.description: Triggered after the file is read

events.name: oversize
events.description: Triggered when the file size limit is exceeded

events.name: remove
events.description: Triggered when deleting a file. There is a true value to prevent deleting a file (support promise)

events.name: preview
events.description: Triggered when a file is preview

events.name: click-action
events.description: Intercept click behavior of upload button

value.type: (index: number, character: string) => VNode | string | null
(inputValue: string, index: number, value: string) => string | boolean

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: The path of the image watermark has a higher priority than `content`

attributes.name: fullscreen
attributes.description: Whether to display watermark in fullscreen mode

slots.name: content
slots.description: The content of HTML `Watermark`, only supports inline styles, does not support passing in self closing tags, priority higher than `content` or `image` attributes
